create.name: Common Ground Meditation Center
create.bio:
Common Ground Meditation Center is an insight meditation community in Minneapolis, grounded in the early Buddhist teachings and in the Western vipassana lineage carried by the Insight Meditation Society and Spirit Rock. Mark Nunberg and his partner Wynn Fricke started it in 1993 in a small storefront that was also their home, and Mark still leads it as co-guiding teacher alongside Shelly Graf, who joined him in that role in 2021. A wider circle of dharma teachers and trained lay leaders, several of them graduates of its own leadership programme, teaches with them.

Since 2009 the centre has occupied a converted diner on East 26th Street in the Seward area, where drop-in sits, yoga, weekly practice groups with talks, introductory mindfulness courses and half-day and daylong retreats take place, most with a Zoom option. Peer-led community groups meet around shared identities and interests. In 2013 the community bought 46 wooded acres near Prairie Farm in western Wisconsin and turned the old barn into a meditation hall for residential retreats and practice periods. Nothing is charged: the centre runs on generosity, and hundreds of recorded talks are shared on YouTube and Dharma Seed.

courses.title: Residential Retreats at Common Ground Retreat Center
courses.description: Teacher-led silent retreats and peer-led practice periods on 46 acres of woods and fields near Prairie Farm, Wisconsin, about 80 miles from the city centre. Retreatants share the cooking and cleaning, and the converted barn serves as the meditation hall.

free_resources.title: New to meditation?
free_resources.description: Common Ground's starting page for beginners, pointing to its multi-week introductory mindfulness course, weekly practice groups and peer-led community groups, plus recordings of a recent introductory course taught by Mark Nunberg.

free_resources.title: What is mindful awareness practice?
free_resources.description: A short essay by guiding teacher Mark Nunberg on what mindfulness asks of us, from settling the heart and mind to returning to the present again and again, on the cushion and in everyday life.

free_resources.title: Sitting and Check-In Community Group
free_resources.description: An hour of silent sitting on Zoom every weekday morning, hosted by a rotating group of community members, with an optional check-in about practice afterwards. Drop in at any point during the hour.
